title: Triage review (Supported for S, I, D; X, E not checked) of the digestion-driven predator ecology on fresh seed 54 at 256^2: ~185 comet predators coexist with ~189 prey; predators 42 persistent splits (generation 3), prey 59 (generation 3); every division is a joint fission of a prey-predator pair
summary: Re-ran the claimed world at 256^2 on seed 54. Labkit species counts replicate the claim within seed noise (predators 81 persistent tracks, 42 persistent splits, generation 3; prey 88, 59, 3); tracked channel by channel, all 67 predator and 92 prey persistent splits happen next to the other kind, and random strips show a predator bridging two prey that pinches with them. The predators are separate comets on the outside of the prey. I did not run the twin or the forks.

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, triage only: no predator-free twin and no forks run by me. Divisions are joint fissions of prey-predator pairs (all splits next to the other kind); the composite merge/split ratio is 1.07, the per-species ratios 0.35-0.39.
